title: Black Friday and £100 energy payment scam warning
body: West Mercia Police's November fraud bulletin warns that fake Black Friday deals are being offered all month. Buy only from retailers you trust, check website addresses carefully, avoid links in unexpected emails and be wary of pressure to act quickly or pay by bank transfer. Criminals may also use the one-off £100 energy payment due to eligible households in January 2027: only your own council will contact you about it, so never give bank details to anyone who calls, texts or emails. If you have been scammed, contact Report Fraud on 0300 123 2040.
